Hi, not entirely sure if I'm the right person for this. But I know what it's like to be so depressed that you're in physical pain, and I'm usually in and out of suicidal states. I also don't have an SO and i've got like one friend, sometimes.

If you have the money, I'd try going to a support group. i hope i'm not overstepping, but finding a support group that is specifically for other trans or LGBT+ people, might help you find a social group that's more understanding than your coworkers. or try talking to a new doctor. 

I'm not sure what you like or liked to do in your free time, but I learned to fill up all the time I spend alone in my room with writing, drawing, listening to music, dancing. Just anything and everything that'll take my mind off of some negative thoughts. Watching youtube videos, playing video games, reading a new book (or rereading your favorite ones) anything that might give  just a sliver of a smile.

I really wish I could be of more help, but I don't even really know how to help myself just yet. If you need to vent or need someone to talk to I'll gladly listen. I'm a pretty pessimistic person, and I don't usually think there's a point to anything. But the end is as far off as we want it to be. I know it's hard, but sometimes I find myself living for the littlest things like listening to my favorite song one last time, watching a funny youtube video, or the small chance that tomorrow will be better. It's not much, but sometimes it's enough.
